name: Under The Sink
summary: Under-the-Sink RO UV UF Alkaline Water Purifier delivers pure, safe, and mineral-rich drinking water with advanced RO, UV, and UF purification technology. Its compact design saves kitchen space while providing efficient filtration, improved taste, and balanced mineral enrichment for modern homes.
intro: Upgrade your kitchen with an advanced Under-the-Sink RO UV UF Alkaline Water Purifier designed to deliver clean, safe, and mineral-rich drinking water while keeping your countertop neat and clutter-free. Its compact under-sink installation saves valuable kitchen space without compromising purification performance.
features: Advanced RO + UV + UF Purification Technology
5 Micron Sediment Filter for removing dust, rust, and fine particles
100 GPD Imported Pump for efficient water pressure management
100 GPD RO Membrane for reducing dissolved impurities and excess TDS
Coconut Shell Activated Carbon Filter (1100 IV) for improved taste and chlorine & odor removal
UVC LED with Stainless Steel Barrel for enhanced microbial protection
BIO AA+ Alkaline Filter to enrich water with essential minerals and support balanced pH
Manual TDS Adjuster for customized mineral level control
